chapter_title_en: The Calamity of the Sky Dog
chapter_seo_title: Chapter 549: The Calamity of the Sky Dog – Li Huowang Enters a Darkened Great Qi
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang discovers the Director’s Office placed an illusory spy beside him without his knowledge. He then enters Great Qi, only to face a world plunged into eternal darkness by a Heavenly Calamity.
og_description: Li Huowang enters Great Qi and finds a world devoured by an endless solar eclipse, full of invisible horrors.
twitter_description: The Director’s spy is caught, but the real nightmare begins when Li Huowang steps into a land without the sun.

lore_anchors.definition: An ancient Chinese folk explanation for a solar eclipse, where a celestial dog swallows the sun. In this novel, it is a literal Heavenly Calamity that plunges the world into endless, deadly darkness.

A twisted expansion of the Buddhist Eight Sufferings. In the Dao-Twisted World, this concept is weaponized: looking at certain supernatural entities triggers these internal “sufferings,” causing bodily harm and insanity.
A young woman from Li Huowang’s past; in this chapter, it is revealed that the version standing before him is a perfect illusion created by the Director’s Office.
The neighboring empire to Great Liang, now consumed by a perpetual Heavenly Calamity that has turned it into a hunting ground for evil spirits.
A mysterious location within Great Qi that Li Huowang is trying to reach, ostensibly to trade a secret for the Director’s help.
A government-sponsored supernormal law enforcement body; the Director’s Office is a branch skilled in surveillance, illusion, and manipulation.
